body: Verdict NEEDS_WORK rather than PASS: 5 of the 43 real command records use message-first tag order (skill commands) and stay hidden; alternative of accepting name-first only was rejected because the spec counts all 43.

Used the last </command-args> delimiter and treated a wholly absent command-args tag as empty; rejected the review item 1 blanket split_once suggestion because it would preserve truncation when args contain a literal closing tag.

Verified against all real jsonl with a differential old(main)-vs-new render harness instead of re-running census.py: any brief/full change outside records containing <command-name> would flag misclassification; none found. Alternative (reuse author census) rejected as non-independent.
